moved.sentence: Set a listener on the relevant view and consume insets:

judged.note: The Views-scoped instruction to set a listener on the relevant view and consume insets is kept at SHOULD; the listener code example it introduced stays in the android-views part.

moved.sentence: Use `WindowInsetsCompat.Type.ime()` for keyboard-aware layouts; do not hardcode bottom padding.

judged.note: Both halves kept at SHOULD / SHOULD NOT: use WindowInsetsCompat.Type.ime() for keyboard-aware layouts and do not hardcode bottom padding.

moved.sentence: For Android 10 (API 29) and below, call `ViewGroupCompat.installCompatInsetsDispatch(rootView)` (androidx-core 1.16.0+) before consuming so sibling views still receive insets.

judged.note: Kept at SHOULD with the Android 10 (API 29) and below condition, the androidx-core 1.16.0+ requirement, the before-consuming ordering and the sibling-views reason.

moved.sentence: Many Material Components (`BottomAppBar`, `BottomNavigationView`, `NavigationRailView`, `NavigationView`) consume insets automatically; `AppBarLayout` does not — add `android:fitsSystemWindows="true"` for its top inset.

judged.note: The list of Material Components that consume insets, the AppBarLayout exception and the fitsSystemWindows fix for its top inset are all kept, the fix at SHOULD.

moved.sentence: Apps **MUST NOT** rely on `android:windowOptOutEdgeToEdgeEnforcement` as a long-term fix.

judged.note: Kept at MUST NOT, including the long-term-fix qualifier and the one-release-stopgap guidance.

moved.sentence: For backward compatibility on Android 14 (API 34) and below, call `enableEdgeToEdge()` in `onCreate()` so behavior is consistent across versions.

judged.note: Kept at SHOULD with the Android 14 (API 34) and below condition, the onCreate() placement and the cross-version consistency reason.

moved.sentence: Prefer the `safeDrawing` inset type for general content; it composes `systemBars`, `displayCutout`, and `ime`.

judged.note: Kept at SHOULD with the general-content scope and the note that safeDrawing composes systemBars, displayCutout and ime.

moved.sentence: The app MUST consume `WindowInsets` so that content, controls, and the keyboard are never obscured.

judged.note: Kept at MUST with the never-obscured purpose, and the rule now states the targetSdk 35 / Android 15+ condition the intro paragraph supplied.

moved.sentence: Wrap top-level UI in `Scaffold`; it applies `safeDrawing` insets and exposes the consumed `innerPadding`.

judged.note: Kept at SHOULD, scoped to Jetpack Compose, with the reason that Scaffold applies safeDrawing insets and exposes innerPadding.

moved.sentence: **Apply that padding** — ignoring it reintroduces the bug.

judged.note: Kept at SHOULD with the referent made explicit (the Scaffold's innerPadding) and the reason that ignoring it reintroduces the bug.

moved.sentence: For manual control, use `Modifier.windowInsetsPadding(...)` with the right inset type:

judged.note: Kept at SHOULD for manual Compose control, and the rule carries the full nested list of inset types (safeDrawing, systemBars, ime) the lead-in introduced.

moved.sentence: Let content scroll **edge to edge** but pad the interactive/last items, e.g. apply `contentPadding` to a `LazyColumn` instead of padding the whole list, so content draws under the bars while items stay reachable.

judged.note: Kept at SHOULD with the LazyColumn contentPadding example and the reason that content draws under the bars while items stay reachable.

moved.sentence: **MUST NOT** return `WindowInsetsCompat.CONSUMED` from a parent if child views also need the same insets — consuming stops dispatch downward.

judged.note: Kept at MUST NOT with the child-views-need-the-same-insets condition and the dispatch-stops-downward reason.

moved.sentence: **MUST NOT** mix `fitsSystemWindows="true"` with manual inset listeners on the same view; pick one strategy per view.

judged.note: Kept at MUST NOT for the same view, with the one-strategy-per-view guidance.

moved.sentence: Test in both gesture and 3-button navigation, with a display cutout, and with the keyboard open.

judged.note: The test matrix (gesture and 3-button navigation, display cutout, keyboard open) is kept at SHOULD.
